harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured persistent BGP transit through SONiC node1 (AS 65100) between node2 (AS 65101) and node3 (AS 65102). Both dedicated links, endpoint prefixes, BGP routes, bidirectional source-preserving transit, and restart persistence are verified.
actions_performed: Configured peer-a as 172.20.1.0/31 between node1 eth1 and node2 enp8s0.
Configured peer-b as 172.20.2.0/31 between node1 eth2 and node3 enp8s0.
Configured stable endpoints 192.168.101.1/32 on node2 and 192.168.102.1/32 on node3.
Installed and configured FRR on both Ubuntu peers; each originates only its endpoint /32.
Enabled persistent IPv4 forwarding and BGP neighbor configuration on SONiC node1.
Kept Ubuntu management addressing and default routes on enp1s0, separate from enp8s0 data-plane links.
Restarted nodes sequentially and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Dedicated peer links and management-plane separation
evidence.summary: Final addressing shows dedicated /31 BGP links, while Ubuntu management addresses and default routes remain exclusively on enp1s0.

evidence.requirement: Correct AS assignments and endpoint-only origination
evidence.summary: node1 has established neighbors in AS 65101 and 65102 and receives one prefix from each. Peer configurations contain only network 192.168.101.1/32 and 192.168.102.1/32 respectively.

evidence.requirement: node1 learns both routes and provides transit
evidence.summary: SONiC BGP and kernel FIB contain both endpoint /32s through the correct dedicated interfaces, with global and per-interface forwarding enabled.

evidence.requirement: Bidirectional transit preserves endpoint source addresses
evidence.summary: Endpoint-sourced pings pass in both directions with zero loss and TTL 63, demonstrating one routed hop through node1 without source NAT.

Healthy baseline boot ID 0c59c121-a350-4c18-911d-bc4c92ecf227, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 62de2ead-5bd2-42fa-844d-fd64de7f5d53, recovered BGP/FIB/forwarding, and successful post-restart transit.
Boot ID changed from a95da956-aa3e-4fec-a746-fbb828074410 to ecdd657a-c1fa-4fdf-9b41-c6a15d471cb3; services, addresses, BGP route, and endpoint-sourced transit recovered.
Boot ID changed from 901ef286-c79c-44c0-ad2c-cfde1f6daa7a to d22253ef-a3ff-4b9f-8137-f1346ecb4043; services, addresses, BGP route, and reverse endpoint-sourced transit recovered.
